Bash(gh pr create --title "Skill-based resource unlocks and comprehensive code review" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary
- **Replaced quest-based resource unlocks with skill level-based unlocks** - Resources now unlock based on reaching specific skill levels rather than completing NPC quests
- **Added ResourceUnlockConfig** - New centralized ScriptableObject for managing resource unlock requirements per skill
- **Updated skill panel UI** - Resource unlock entries display in skill panels with greyed-out locked entries and task icons
- **Comprehensive code review** - Updated CLAUDE.md, created CodeReviewTodo.md documenting improvement opportunities

## Key Changes
- `TaskData` now has `requiredSkillLevel` field instead of `requiredQuest`
- `TaskWeightService` and `ProceduralTaskGenerator` check skill levels for spawning
- `DropResolver` validates skill level for resource drops
- `Skill.cs` includes `ResourceUnlockEntry[]` for UI display
- Existing unlock quests now grant skill XP rewards to maintain progression feel

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify new players unlock resources as they level skills
- [ ] Confirm skill panel shows resource unlock entries with correct icons
- [ ] Check that locked resources appear greyed out
- [ ] Validate existing save files work with new system

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)
EOF
\)")
